title: A linked entry with no category takes the category picked
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a Part Library entry that has no category and that no part at the test location uses (such entries come from data saved before this release); call its part number number 1.
  • Use any category, category A, from the Category list.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Click New Inventory Part.
  2. Type a description in the Description field.
  3. Type number 1 in the Part Number field, with the same upper and lower case.
  4. Pick category A in the Category field.
  5. Type 10.00 in the Cost field.
  6. Click Save.
  7. Click Part Library in the left menu.
  8. Type number 1 in the Part Library search.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Inventory Part window opens.

Step 2:

  • Description holds the text.

Step 3:

  • Part Number reads number 1.

Step 4:

  • Category reads category A.

Step 5:

  • Cost reads $10.00.

Step 6:

  • The window closes and the part is saved.

Step 7:

  • The Part Library page opens.

Step 8:

  • Exactly one entry has number 1, and it now shows category A: an entry with no category takes the one picked.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10820 (Story 7, Create a Part by Typing Its Number and Description)

  • S7-R6c: “A linked entry with no category takes the one picked in the dialog. An entry that already has a category keeps it.”
  • S7-R6b: “A linked entry with no manufacturer takes the one picked in the dialog. An entry that already has a manufacturer keeps it.”

From: Jira tickets and comments under epic SV-10647 (saved in sources/jira-2026-10-27/ALL-TICKETS-2026-10-27.md), read 27 Oct 2026

  • SV-10820, Chris Ward, 23 Oct 2026: “Please switch to B. When the typed number links to a Part Library entry that has no category, the entry takes the category picked in the dialog, the same way a missing manufacturer is filled (S7-R6b). If the entry already has a category, it keeps its own (S7-R6c).”
